name: meta-ads-diagnostics
description: Read-only Meta Ads diagnostics plugin for Codex with local MCP tools for account inspection, campaign reporting, and performance triage.

interface.shortDescription: Read-only Meta Ads reporting and diagnosis.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Meta Ads through a local MCP server for read-only account inspection, campaign insights, and diagnostic summaries. The MVP intentionally excludes write actions such as budget updates, pausing entities, or campaign creation.
defaultPrompt: Validate my Meta Ads connection and list the ad accounts available to this token.
Analyze campaign performance for this ad account and summarize the main diagnostic signals.
Fetch account insights for the last 30 days and highlight spend, CTR, CPC, CPM, and signs of delivery issues.
